description: This file defines the API and data structures for the Reset Controller driver in Zephyr RTOS, including macros for device tree integration and function prototypes for reset operations.

methods.name: reset_status
methods.description: Gets the reset status of a device or from a devicetree specification.

methods.name: reset_line_assert
methods.description: Asserts the reset line of a device or from a devicetree specification.

methods.name: reset_line_deassert
methods.description: Deasserts the reset line of a device or from a devicetree specification.

methods.name: reset_line_toggle
methods.description: Performs a reset cycle (assert + deassert) on the reset line of a device or from a devicetree specification.
